import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define file paths for all sources
    path_source0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_0.csv"
    path_source1 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_1.csv"
    path_source2 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_2.csv"
    path_source3 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_3.csv"
    path_source4 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_4.csv"

    # Load all source tables
    df_causa = pd.read_csv(path_source0)
    df_deteccion = pd.read_csv(path_source1)
    df_main = pd.read_csv(path_source2)
    df_actividad = pd.read_csv(path_source3)
    df_factor = pd.read_csv(path_source4)

    # Inspect columns to avoid duplicate columns after merges
    # The main dataframe (df_main) already contains textual columns for Causa, Deteccion, Factor, Actividad
    # The source tables 0,1,3,4 provide mappings from Id to text for these columns.
    # We will join on the Id columns in df_main to get consistent textual values from the source tables.
    # Then we will drop the textual columns from df_main to avoid duplicates and keep the source tables' textual columns.

    # Merge df_main with df_causa on 'Causa' text to get 'IdCausa' from df_causa
    # But df_main already has 'Causa' text and df_causa has 'IdCausa' and 'Causa' text.
    # We want to ensure the IdCausa in df_main matches the IdCausa in df_causa.
    # However, df_main does not have IdCausa column, only textual 'Causa'.
    # So we will merge df_main with df_causa on 'Causa' to get IdCausa.

    # Similarly for Deteccion, Factor, Actividad.

    # Step 1: Merge df_main with df_causa to get IdCausa
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_causa, on='Causa', how='left', suffixes=('', '_causa'))
    # Rename IdCausa from df_causa to avoid confusion
    df_main.rename(columns={'IdCausa': 'IdCausa'}, inplace=True)

    # Step 2: Merge df_main with df_deteccion to get IdDeteccion
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_deteccion, on='Deteccion', how='left', suffixes=('', '_deteccion'))
    df_main.rename(columns={'IdDeteccion': 'IdDeteccion'}, inplace=True)

    # Step 3: Merge df_main with df_actividad to get IdActividad
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_actividad, on='Actividad', how='left', suffixes=('', '_actividad'))
    df_main.rename(columns={'IdActividad': 'IdActividad'}, inplace=True)

    # Step 4: Merge df_main with df_factor to get IdFactor
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_factor, on='Factor', how='left', suffixes=('', '_factor'))
    df_main.rename(columns={'IdFactor': 'IdFactor'}, inplace=True)

    # After merges, df_main has columns:
    # - Original textual columns: Causa, Deteccion, Actividad, Factor
    # - Id columns from source tables: IdCausa, IdDeteccion, IdActividad, IdFactor

    # The target schema expects all these columns plus the original columns from df_main.

    # The source df_main has a column 'Precipitaciones' which is not in target schema, so drop it if exists
    if 'Precipitaciones' in df_main.columns:
        df_main.drop(columns=['Precipitaciones'], inplace=True)

    # The target schema columns in order:
    target_columns = [
        'Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora',
        'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
        'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
        'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion',
        'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Presion',
        'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia',
        'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor'
    ]

    # Check if all target columns exist in df_main, if not create with NaN or appropriate type
    for col in target_columns:
        if col not in df_main.columns:
            # Create missing columns with NaN or appropriate dtype
            if col in ['IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'ID', 'V_Viento', 'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor']:
                df_main[col] = pd.NA
            elif col in ['Edad', 'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min',
                         'Presion', 'Dir. vi.', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia']:
                df_main[col] = pd.NA
            else:
                df_main[col] = pd.NA

    # Reorder columns to target schema order
    df_target = df_main[target_columns]

    # Convert data types according to target schema
    # Fecha: string (keep as is)
    # IdAhogado, IdPersona, ID, V_Viento, IdActividad, IdCausa, IdDeteccion, IdFactor: integer
    int_cols = ['IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'ID', 'V_Viento', 'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor']
    for col in int_cols:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

    # Float columns
    float_cols = ['Edad', 'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min',
                  'Presion', 'Dir. vi.', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia']
    for col in float_cols:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce')

    # String columns: ensure string type and fill NaN with empty string or keep NaN
    str_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in int_cols + float_cols]
    for col in str_cols:
        df_target[col] = df_target[col].astype('string')

    # Write the result to the target path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
